description: Removes one tag from the vault's vocabulary — `kind` says which list — and the rows that wore it are left with no category; nothing else about them changes. A row left without a category shows under "No category" until one is set. Writes are schema-validated and provenance-stamped, and land in the app's Changes screen where the owner keeps or undoes the whole batch. Card numbers, CVVs and credentials are refused by the validator, which names the row. `source` ("documents/hdfc-2026.pdf", "gmail:18c2…") records where a row came from in the diff.

kind.description: Which list the tag belongs to.

name.description: The tag as the vault holds it, any casing.

name: delete_tag
title: Delete a tag
